title: LibScript TFRC Zero-Cost Policy Variables
description: Domain-scoped configuration variables governing TPU Research Cloud (TFRC) zero-cost billing guardrails and ephemeral VM TTLs.

LIBSCRIPT_TFRC_CONFIG.description: Explicit filesystem path to the user-supplied TFRC zero-cost policy JSON file validated against schemas/tfrc-policy.schema.json.

LIBSCRIPT_TFRC_STRICT.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing zero-cost TFRC guardrails (blocking GKE, Persistent Disks, static IPs, and non-matching GCS regions).

LIBSCRIPT_TFRC_STORAGE_MODE.description: Artifact and code transfer transport mode under TFRC enforcement (ssh default, or verified same_region_gcs).

LIBSCRIPT_TFRC_MAX_TTL_MINUTES.description: Maximum time-to-live in minutes armed on provisioned TPU VM workers via the dead-man's switch timer.

LIBSCRIPT_TFRC_SHM_MIN_FREE_GB.description: Minimum free /dev/shm tmpfs capacity in GiB preserved before evicting completed per-backend virtual environments.
